articles.summary: Martin Dewhurst appointed as independent director and member of the Audit and Compensation Committees Veteran healthcare executive brings more than 30 years of leadership, governance, and strategic advisory experience ROCKVILLE, Md., Sept. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NovaBridge Biosciences
articles.title: NovaBridge Appoints Martin Dewhurst to Board of Directors as an Independent Director
